summary: The reimagining of Dark Yugi's Duelist Kingdom deck: Black Luster Soldier and Magician of Black Chaos return as a dual-purpose Ritual series. One Ritual Spell summons either boss monster and keeps recurring itself, while Mind Shuffle loops resources between the two. Grindy control/midrange with the most developed combo lines of any new CORI archetype so far.

cards.name: Ritual of Light and Darkness
cards.effectText: Ritual Summons “Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos” or “Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness” by tributing monsters and/or banishing from your GY to meet the Ritual Summon's Level requirement. Once per turn, add this card plus 1 card that mentions it from your GY to your hand.

cards.name: Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness
cards.effectText: Must first be Ritual Summoned. Cannot be destroyed by battle. Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects unless they target this card. If this card destroys a monster by battle: it gains 1500 ATK and can make a second attack in the same Battle Phase.

cards.name: Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos
cards.effectText: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, and cannot be Ritual Summoned except as noted. Can be Special Summoned by shuffling 1 Spellcaster or Warrior Ritual Monster from your hand or GY into the Deck. Protects your Spells/Traps and can banish cards your opponent controls.

cards.name: Skull Archfiend of Chaos
cards.effectText: When this card is sent to the GY: send “Ritual of Light and Darkness” from your Deck to the GY, then add a Ritual Monster it can Ritual Summon from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Mind Shuffle
cards.effectText: Core resource-loop card of the archetype — shuffles/recycles Ritual pieces between hand, Deck, and GY to keep swapping between the deck's two Ritual boss monsters. Exact wording still being confirmed from early previews.

cards.name: Griffoh
cards.effectText: Lets you use “Mind Shuffle” the same turn it's Set, enabling the deck's core loop a turn earlier. Exact stats/wording still being confirmed from early previews.

comboLines.title: Mind Shuffle grind loop
comboLines.body: Send Skull Archfiend of Chaos to the GY to send Ritual of Light and Darkness to the GY and tutor a Ritual Monster, then use Mind Shuffle to recur pieces and Ritual Summon. Set Griffoh to enable Mind Shuffle the same turn. Swap between Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness (offense, battle-destruction snowball) and Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos (protection/banish) depending on board state. Documented in early OCG/community coverage as the deck's core engine, though exact card wording is still being confirmed.

sampleDecklist.label: Community-documented list with a real combo engine (Mind Shuffle loop) — more developed than most other new CORI archetypes, but still not a tournament Top Cut list.
